Nostr separates your identity from the app you happen to use.

Our 4 minute 38 second Nostr WoT tutorial follows the model from keys and signatures to signed notes, independent relays and interchangeable clients. The companion guide explains the same foundations in seven languages.

The app is replaceable. Your key is the continuity.

We made this introduction for people who are still mapping Nostr to familiar social platforms. It shows why the same public key can work across clients without turning any one client into the owner of the account.

Relays still choose what they store, clients still choose what they show, and losing the private key can mean losing control of the identity.
